title: SMProfile-ProductDefinition payload (NATS, MQTT)
description: GENERATED from standard/profiles/operations/product-definition.json 2.1.0 by i3x-v5 packages/schemas-ci/gen-payloads.mjs; do not edit by hand. Shape: entity (envelope.schema.json).

name.description: Display name of the product specification.

version_label.description: Functional spec/recipe version (independent of the profile SemVer).

status.description: Lifecycle status, e.g. draft, released, obsolete.

article_ref.description: FK to Article.article_no, reached via OperationsSegment SPECIFIES_MATERIAL. The article this spec defines — the production order / recipe join point. First binding axis.

equipment_class_ref.description: Optional FK to an EquipmentClass/line the spec is restricted to, reached via OperationsSegment SPECIFIES_EQUIPMENT. Second binding axis.

param_name.description: Name of the controlled product property (e.g. a speed, a thickness or a weight per area).

target_value.description: Target / SOLL setpoint of the property.

unit.description: Unit of the property (UN/CEFACT code recommended).

updated_at.description: Last change. Server-managed and volatile on every read (sim-v5 returns a fresh value per GET), so promotion:never — kept in the snapshot but excluded from the change-trigger and never published on its own.

operations_type.description: ISA-95 operations type (B2MML OperationsType; Part 3/4: which MOM area the object belongs to; audit M1). A source without the column sets the constant of the profile's momDomain (columnMappings const).

characteristic_ref.description: The characteristic the band of this parameter comes from: the criterion of the test specification (SMProfile-TestSpecificationCriterion, e.g. the balloon number on the drawing). Empty until a real source names it — never invented.

source_revision.description: The revision of the drawing or document that set the band. Empty until a real source names it — never invented.
